To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the key success factors for the development and implementation of age-friendly practices are: 1) establishing a dedicated age-friendly agency to trigger, develop, implement and promote age-friendly programs; 2) creating partnerships with local government and other organizations; 3) building awareness and public support through the media; 4) building on local culture; 5) encouraging civic engagement; 6) starting small; 7) providing recognition and credit; 8) hiring paid staff.

the age-friendly programs can be successfully implemented at a local level and then replicated at the regional level, if a strong and committed agency is established, partnerships are built, media and public relations are maintained, culture is built on, civic engagement is expanded, small steps are taken, recognition and credit are given.
age-friendly programs can be developed in different settings and with different stakeholders.
